const suggestionAction = async (suggestion, action) => { try { const result = await api.action("skills/suggestions", suggestion.id, action); if (action === "accept") { toast({ status: "success", title: "Suggestion accepted as a draft" }); setView("skillDetail", result.skill.id); } else { toast({ status: "success", title: "Suggestion dismissed" }); refreshSuggestions(); } } catch (e) { toast({ status: "error", title: e.message }); } };

const refreshMaterials = async () => { if (!id) return; try { const result = await api.request(`/skills/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/materials`); setMaterials(result.items || []); } catch (e) { toast({ status: "error", title: e.message }); } };
